achievements.name: Hollow Victory
achievements.description: Reach the conclusion of the game.

achievements.name: Fully Equipped
achievements.description: Unlock all Weapons, Trinkets, Cloaks, and Upgrades.

achievements.name: Hollowin' Again!
achievements.description: Finish the game in New Game Plus.

achievements.name: Thorne Beater
achievements.description: Defeat Thorne for the first time.

achievements.name: Sparks of Genius
achievements.description: Restore half of the Spark Generators.

achievements.name: Big Spender
achievements.description: Spend a combined 50,000 Bones in shops.

achievements.name: First Purchase
achievements.description: Buy your first item.

achievements.name: Fishin' Reactor
achievements.description: Acquire all trophies on the Fish Board.

achievements.name: Renegade Roundup
achievements.description: Defeat Armand, Maxi, Willis, the Dugin, and Evra.

achievements.name: Minigame Master
achievements.description: Master all Racing, Ring Dive, and Wrecker challenges.

achievements.name: Hardifier
achievements.description: Finish the game with 3 active Hard Modifiers.

achievements.name: Weirdifier
achievements.description: Finish the game with 3 active Weird Modifiers.

achievements.name: Speed Runner
achievements.description: Complete the game in under 4 hours.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.description: Defeat a Spark Generator boss without taking damage.

achievements.name: Bone Pincher
achievements.description: Finish the game without spending any Bones in shops.

achievements.name: Bone Keeper
achievements.description: Complete the game without ever losing your Bones.

achievements.name: Off the Grid
achievements.description: Finish the game without ever entering the Underlab.

achievements.name: Steed Hopper
achievements.description: Using the Iron Steed, hop on 3 enemies' heads without touching the ground.

achievements.name: Drag Race
achievements.description: Ride the Iron Steed across 6 unique screens without doubling back.

achievements.name: Bounding Bonanza
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a Bounding Bomb explosion, after both orbs bounce 3 times.

achievements.name: Skippin' Stone
achievements.description: Kill an enemy across 8 tiles of water using the Hollower's Rocks.

achievements.name: Four-Point Hatchet
achievements.description: Hit 4 enemies, one with each spark of a single Volt Hatchet.

achievements.name: Boomerang Blade
achievements.description: Kill 2 foes with a single Gyro Dagger, changing its direction with each strike.

achievements.name: Wormhole
achievements.description: Kill an enemy after warping from offscreen with the Recall Disc.

achievements.name: Bashful
achievements.description: Strike 3 enemies with one charge of the Drill Driver.

achievements.name: Light 'em Up
achievements.description: Avoid a certain fate in the darkness by using the Dynamo Lantern.

achievements.name: Pitfall Parasol
achievements.description: Knock multiple enemies into a pit using a single Deflector Parasol.

achievements.name: Beckoning Buddy
achievements.description: Keep the Beckoning Collar creature active for most of a boss fight.

achievements.name: Haunting Reach
achievements.description: Hit a foe from 25 tiles away using the Gnawing Ghosts.

achievements.name: Mist Glide
achievements.description: Use the Mist Jar to phase through 3 enemies in one use.

achievements.name: Fogburst
achievements.description: Eliminate 6 enemies using one continuous spray of the Fog Thrower.

achievements.name: Tip Tapper
achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies in a row using Nightstar's Dread Mace upgrade, hitting only with the tip.

achievements.name: Hammerama
achievements.description: Defeat a boss using only fully charged attacks from the Blaststrike Maul.

achievements.name: Sniper Dagger
achievements.description: Kill a boss with Whisper and Vesper thrown from across the screen.

achievements.name: Perfect Guard
achievements.description: Parry 15 consecutive attacks with the Guardian Casket.

achievements.name: Buster Bounce
achievements.description: Defeat 3 enemies in a row with only double bank shots using the Battery Buster.

achievements.name: Combo Conductor
achievements.description: While in combat, maintain max combo with the Chain Capacitor Trinket for 10 seconds.

achievements.name: Shock Tactician
achievements.description: Defeat a boss using a spark from the Shock Flint Trinket.

achievements.name: Plasma Survivor
achievements.description: Fill your reserve tank with the Plasma Jug Trinket while at 1 HP.

achievements.name: Joule Junkie
achievements.description: Kill a boss while at 1 HP, using only Sidearms and the Joule Syringe Trinket.

achievements.name: Pendulum Master
achievements.description: Parry 10 attacks without getting hit using the Dodging Pendulum Trinket.

achievements.name: Traumatized
achievements.description: Complete the hidden Poppit merchant side quest - buy from every hidden Poppit shop - and watch the disturbing Grinnsly dance scene.

achievements.name: Masochist
achievements.description: Defeat a boss while wearing exactly 3 Beastium Trinkets.

achievements.name: Pawned Off
achievements.description: Sell the maximum number of items at Pawnty's Exchange.

achievements.name: Bonestone Tycoon
achievements.description: Convert over 20,000 in the Bone Sinterer in one go.

achievements.name: Lopsided
achievements.description: Raise one stat to 10 while keeping all others at 3 or below.

achievements.name: Below Zero
achievements.description: Finish the game with -1% Collection or less.

achievements.name: Trash Juggler
achievements.description: Knock the kids' can below the bottom of the bridge.

achievements.name: Opossum Impressem
achievements.description: Show Lena that you can clear 10 tiles without touching the ground.

achievements.name: Feat Accompli
achievements.description: Earn all other Feats.
